subject: puss caterpillar
title: This Fluffy Caterpillar Hides Venom Spines That Can Hurt for 12 Hours

scenes.text: This caterpillar looks soft enough to pet. That's the trap.
The puss caterpillar is an inch long and looks like a tiny fur toupee.
Under that soft coat hide stiff, hollow spines, each with a venom gland at its base.
Brush against it and the spines break off in your skin, leaving a red grid of marks.
Stings can bring headache, nausea, fever, and pain for up to twelve hours.
The fluffier it looks, the older it is, and the more spines hide underneath.

description:
The puss caterpillar looks like a tiny fur toupee, but stiff venomous spines hide under the fluff.
The spines break off in the skin and can cause intense burning pain, headache, nausea and fever.
Would you have touched it?
first_comment: It grows up into the southern flannel moth, which is fuzzy too but harmless. Have you ever been stung by a caterpillar?
